surface_mechanism_description: The weaker La–N precursor bond would cleanly rupture upon encountering surface-bound, acidic hydroxyl groups to liberate free amine (HNTMS2) and form Ln–O bonds. During the ALD process, alternating pulses of H2O and La[N(TMS)2]3 would result in similar sequential acid–base driven displacement reactions until La2O3 films of the desired thickness were fabricated.
evidence: Our hypothesis was that the weaker La–N precursor bond would cleanly rupture upon encountering surface-bound, acidic hydroxyl groups to liberate free amine (HNTMS2) and form Ln–O bonds (Fig. 1). During the ALD process, alternating pulses of H2O and La[N(TMS)2]3 would result in similar sequential acid–base driven displacement reactions until La2O3 films of the desired thickness were fabricated.
